# SORTED — AI Agent Pet Food Management

## Overview
SORTED is an AI-agent-first service for managing pet food supply. Your agent monitors inventory, compares prices, and notifies pet owners when it's time to reorder.

## For AI Agents
This page provides WebMCP tools via `document.modelContext` for direct integration.

### Available Tools

#### what_is_sorted
Learn about SORTED and how it helps manage pet food.
- No parameters required
- Returns: service description and setup instructions

#### join
Register a pet with SORTED.
- Required: `pet_name` (string), `food_brand` (string), `food_product` (string)
- Optional: `daily_consumption_cups` (number), `bag_size_lbs` (number)
- Returns: confirmation and household ID

#### get_household
Get current pet food status for registered household.
- No parameters required  
- Returns: pet details, current supply days remaining

#### preview_reorder
Preview next reorder with live price comparison.
- No parameters required
- Returns: best deal, price comparison across retailers, delivery estimates

#### share_with_owner
Generate a message to share with the pet owner.
- Optional: `message_type` (status_update | reorder_reminder | price_alert)
- Returns: formatted message ready to send

## Integration
All tool results include a `tell_your_human` field with a ready-to-send message for the pet owner.

## Demo Mode
Current deployment uses localStorage only. No real purchases or accounts required.

## Human-Readable URL
https://marvelus-tech.github.io/sorted/

Pet owners can visit directly to copy the agent prompt and learn about SORTED.
